title: {{NAME}} and the Fairy Who Fixed Everything
moral: When you ask for help and work together, even the biggest problems can be solved.

pages.content: {{NAME}} walked into the garden one morning. He saw a tiny robot sitting by the flowers. The little robot was making sad beeping sounds. Its left arm had fallen right off. {{NAME}} looked around the big sunny garden. He wondered how to help.
